name: port_forge
title: PortForge
description: 35 个知名 TCP/UDP 端口参考表，按端口号或服务名即时搜索，可按协议过滤。
core:
var PORTS=[
{port:20,proto:'TCP',service:'FTP (数据)',desc:'文件传输协议数据通道'},
{port:21,proto:'TCP',service:'FTP (控制)',desc:'文件传输协议控制通道'},
{port:22,proto:'TCP',service:'SSH',desc:'安全外壳远程登录'},
{port:23,proto:'TCP',service:'Telnet',desc:'明文远程终端（不安全）'},
{port:25,proto:'TCP',service:'SMTP',desc:'简单邮件传输'},
{port:53,proto:'TCP/UDP',service:'DNS',desc:'域名解析'},
{port:67,proto:'UDP',service:'DHCP (服务端)',desc:'动态主机配置'},
{port:68,proto:'UDP',service:'DHCP (客户端)',desc:'动态主机配置'},
{port:69,proto:'UDP',service:'TFTP',desc:'简单文件传输'},
{port:80,proto:'TCP',service:'HTTP',desc:'万维网'},
{port:110,proto:'TCP',service:'POP3',desc:'邮件接收'},
{port:123,proto:'UDP',service:'NTP',desc:'网络时间协议'},
{port:137,proto:'UDP',service:'NetBIOS',desc:'名称服务'},
{port:139,proto:'TCP',service:'NetBIOS',desc:'会话服务'},
{port:143,proto:'TCP',service:'IMAP',desc:'邮件接收'},
{port:161,proto:'UDP',service:'SNMP',desc:'简单网络管理'},
{port:443,proto:'TCP',service:'HTTPS',desc:'加密万维网'},
{port:445,proto:'TCP',service:'SMB',desc:'文件共享'},
{port:465,proto:'TCP',service:'SMTPS',desc:'加密邮件发送'},
{port:587,proto:'TCP',service:'SMTP (提交)',desc:'邮件提交'},
{port:993,proto:'TCP',service:'IMAPS',desc:'加密邮件接收'},
{port:995,proto:'TCP',service:'POP3S',desc:'加密邮件接收'},
{port:1433,proto:'TCP',service:'MSSQL',desc:'SQL Server'},
{port:1521,proto:'TCP',service:'Oracle',desc:'Oracle 数据库'},
{port:3306,proto:'TCP',service:'MySQL',desc:'MySQL 数据库'},
{port:3389,proto:'TCP',service:'RDP',desc:'远程桌面'},
{port:5432,proto:'TCP',service:'PostgreSQL',desc:'PostgreSQL 数据库'},
{port:6379,proto:'TCP',service:'Redis',desc:'Redis 数据库'},
{port:8080,proto:'TCP',service:'HTTP-alt',desc:'HTTP 替代端口'},
{port:8443,proto:'TCP',service:'HTTPS-alt',desc:'HTTPS 替代端口'},
{port:27017,proto:'TCP',service:'MongoDB',desc:'MongoDB 数据库'}];
function search(list,kw){kw=(kw||'').toLowerCase();if(!kw)return list;return list.filter(function(x){return (String(x.port)+' '+x.proto+' '+x.service+' '+x.desc).toLowerCase().indexOf(kw)>=0;});}
function byProto(list,proto){return list.filter(function(x){return x.proto.toLowerCase().indexOf(proto.toLowerCase())>=0;});}
var EXPORTS={PORTS:PORTS,search:search,byProto:byProto};


function rngFactory(seed){ var s=(seed>>>0)||1; return function(){ s=(s*1664525+1013904223)>>>0; return s/4294967296; }; }

if (typeof module !== 'undefined' && module.exports) { module.exports = EXPORTS; }
if (typeof window !== 'undefined') { window.PortForgePure = EXPORTS; }
